raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "cut_cross_entropy" %}
{% set version = "25.1.1" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/cut_cross_entropy-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5fe5924509248b1aea5c890f8887c6a7759f7c8b1ebc0490e42c247c4f7c1e34

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - setuptools-scm
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pytorch
    - triton

test:
  imports:
    - cut_cross_entropy
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}.*

about:
  home: https://github.com/unslothai/cut_cross_entropy
  summary: Code for cut cross entropy, a memory efficient implementation of linear-cross-entropy loss.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
